title: FLUX.1 autoencoder (16 latent channels), also Z-Image's VAE

provenance.source: safetensors header of vae/ae.safetensors (335304388 bytes, Comfy-Org/Z-Image-Turbo split_files/vae) on the reference target (ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0 on port 8188, GAPS Q17)
provenance.note: 244 tensors under encoder and decoder; metadata modelspec.architecture Flux.1-AE. decoder.conv_in.weight [512, 16, 3, 3] reads 16 latent channels, and there is no quant_conv or post_quant_conv. The all-in-one FLUX checkpoint carries the same VAE under the vae. prefix with decoder.conv_in [512, 16, 3, 3]. SD 1.x and SDXL VAEs have 4 latent channels and quant_conv; Wan's VAE has encoder.conv1 and no conv_in. The header doesn't tell this VAE from Stable Diffusion 3's, which has the same shapes.
